text:
Before: the plate held 2-3 rice paper rolls (one chicken, one or two with tofu or veggies), about 200 g and roughly 300 kcal. The fruit bowl held about 150 g of mixed fruit (cantaloupe, strawberries, apple, blueberries) at about 70 kcal. There was also a cup of dark sauce (hoisin or soy, about 30 g, 40 kcal) and a cup of pickled ginger (about 20 g, 15 kcal). The water has no calories.

After: the rolls are gone. About 40% of the fruit remains, roughly 60 g. The sauce cup still looks full, and the ginger cup is mostly full with a little missing.

Eaten:
- Rolls: 200 g, about 300 kcal.
- Fruit: about 90 g, about 40 kcal.
- Sauce and ginger: negligible, maybe a few grams.

Total: about 300 g and 345 kcal.
